name: The Barrens Port
summary: Thyn'tel Bladeweaver sends you from Darnassus to Ratchet to search for Velinde Starsong. The Sentinels believe she took a ship across the Great Sea to the Eastern Kingdoms, and her trail leads through dangerous Horde lands.

sections.title: Tracking the Priestess
sections.body: Clues among Velinde Starsong's personal effects suggest she sought passage across the sea to the Eastern Kingdoms. Ratchet is the Barrens' only working harbor, where travelers from northern Kalimdor can arrange passage south or east without sailing from night elf lands. Thyn'tel Bladeweaver sends you south to search the harbor master's ledgers for Velinde's name.

sections.title: A Dangerous Crossing
sections.body: The road to Ratchet crosses the heart of Horde lands. South of Ashenvale, orc outriders and Tauren patrols range across the Mor'shan Rampart and the dry Barrens. Ratchet is governed by the neutral Steamwheedle Cartel, whose goblin law puts trade ahead of faction rivalries. At the docks, Wharfmaster Dizzywig records every passenger and cargo crate.

faq.q: Why do the Sentinels send me into the Barrens?
faq.answer: Ratchet is the main neutral trading port in central Kalimdor. Since Velinde Starsong vanished while seeking passage to the Eastern Kingdoms, the night elves believe she may have booked travel aboard a goblin trading vessel instead of using official military channels.

Wharfmaster Dizzywig oversees departures and cargo records at Ratchet's docks. He works for the Steamwheedle Cartel and keeps ledgers of vessels, passengers, and shipments entering and leaving the harbor.

faq.q: Why would an Alliance member be safe in Ratchet?
aliases: will guards attack me in ratchet
faq.answer: The neutral Steamwheedle Cartel runs Ratchet instead of the Horde. Its goblins put commerce and profit first, and their bruisers keep the peace, allowing Alliance travelers to do business so long as they do not draw weapons inside town.

faq.q: What happens after finding Wharfmaster Dizzywig?
faq.answer: After checking his records, Dizzywig confirms Velinde left aboard a vessel bound for the Eastern Kingdoms. He sends you to Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale to pick up her trail across the Great Sea.

faq.q: How does an Alliance traveler reach Ratchet safely?
aliases: how to get to ratchet alliance
faq.answer: From Ashenvale, Alliance travelers can go south past Silverwing Grove, then skirt the guarded Mor'shan Rampart through the hills just east of the main road. In the Barrens, follow the paths toward the eastern coast to reach Ratchet's docks.

Velinde Starsong was a night elf priestess and Melyria Frostshadow's predecessor in Ashenvale. Charged with cleansing the forest of demons, she made little headway before she disappeared. Her trail now seems to cross the sea.

angles.text: As a night elf, Velinde Starsong's loss weighs heavily on Darnassus's leadership. Retracing her desperate journey is a matter of kaldorei duty.
As an Alliance scout, you cross Horde-patrolled lands in the Barrens before reaching the neutral goblin docks, so caution matters.
